Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

Claim 2 (Cancelled)

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in a manner that does not harm the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __without compromising the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating __the shed cellular material in a non-destructive manner__ and agitation.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __in a manner that does not harm the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

Claim 8 (Original)

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a method that preserves the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __in a manner that does not harm the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that retain viability__.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a manner that maintains their viability__.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __that preserves the integrity of the DNA__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __without compromising the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __while ensuring the viability of the embryos throughout the process__.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __in a manner that preserves the viability of the embryos__.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __while maintaining their viability__.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __in a manner that does not harm their viability__.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __while ensuring the viability of the embryos__.
